subject.title: GitHub: Create two PR templates (small fixes vs substantial changes)

question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick/full PR templates through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96854, or keep the simplified single fallback template?
rationale: This changes the contributor authoring workflow and automation-facing PR body contract, so code inspection can show the surface but cannot decide the desired maintainer policy.

options.title: Accept selectable templates after contract review
options.body: Land the linked PR once the quick/full templates preserve required problem and evidence expectations for external PRs.

options.title: Keep one simplified fallback template
options.body: Reject the split if maintainers prefer one default authoring path and consider the current shorter template sufficient.

options.title: Narrow the split before acceptance
options.body: Ask the linked PR to change template wording or sections before deciding whether selectable templates should become the default workflow.

recommendation.title: Accept selectable templates after contract review
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR once the quick/full templates preserve required problem and evidence expectations for external PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history ties this person to the template, contribution guide, and proof-policy surfaces that the template split must preserve.
